title: Finitely presented module objects
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a monoidal structure whose tensor product is additive in each variable. Let $R$ be a ring object (a monoid object, [sk-def-sfb-ring-object]) of $\mathcal C$ such that $R\otimes-$ is right exact, meaning that it preserves finite colimits. Write $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Mod}_R(\mathcal C)$ for the category of left module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]; it is abelian by [lem-sfb-modobj-abelian]. The regular module is $R$ with its multiplication as action, as in [sk-def-sfb-module-objects].

For $n\in\mathbf N$, let $R^n=\bigoplus_{i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}R$ be the finite biproduct in $\mathcal B$ of $n$ copies of this regular module, with $R^0=0$. Here a finite biproduct has injections $\iota_i$ and projections $\pi_i$ satisfying $\pi_i\iota_j=\delta_{ij}\operatorname{id}_R$ and $\sum_i\iota_i\pi_i=\operatorname{id}_{R^n}$.

An $R$-module object $M$ is *finitely presented* if there exist $m,n\in\mathbf N$, a morphism $f\colon R^m\to R^n$ in $\mathcal B$, and an isomorphism $M\cong\operatorname{coker}_{\mathcal B}(f)$. The cokernel is taken in the module category: it is an object $Q$ with $q\colon R^n\to Q$ such that $qf=0$ and every module morphism $g\colon R^n\to N$ with $gf=0$ factors uniquely as $g=hq$. Finite biproducts and cokernels exist because $\mathcal B$ is abelian [def-sp-abelian].
